title: Dead code after Exit Script
description: Error-prone rule — an executable step directly follows an unconditional Exit Script or Halt Script in the same branch. That step can never run; cleanup placed there (e.g. Close Window) silently never happens.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A step after an unconditional script terminator is unreachable. This frequently hides broken cleanup: the author believed the step runs, but it never does.
rule.remediation: Move the step before the Exit Script / Halt Script, or remove it. If it belongs to another branch, fix the If/Else structure.
